assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
CPT 93271 is medically necessary to identify an underlying arrhythmia source for the recurrent embolic phenomena
The recurrent embolic phenomena are reflected in diagnosis code G45.9
